title: Classical finite systems and normalized raw lisse realization
statement:
Fix $q=p^a$, $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, and $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber; def-weil-algebraic-closure]. Let $W$ be a separated finite-type $k$-scheme [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. For finite $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ in $\Omega$, put $A=\mathcal O_E$, choose $\varpi$, and put $B_W=\varprojlim_{n\geq1}(A/\varpi^n)_W$, $E_W=B_W[1/\varpi]$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension; def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Use the classical lisse categories of [def-pod-lisse-l-adic-sheaves], the sf raw heart [def-weil-constructible-heart], its prescribed scalar realization $\mathcal L_{W,E}$ [lem-tw-lisse-rational-realization], the identity-induced sf/PBC equivalence $J_{W,E}$ [lem-fd-rational-coefficient-category-comparison] and the continuous PBC realization $\mathcal R_{W,E}$ [lem-per-continuous-rational-derived-realization].

For every lisse $B_W$-module $L$, its ordinary quotients $L_n=L/\varpi^nL$ descend to finite locally free sheaves on $W_{\mathrm{et}}$, with
$$L_{n+1}\otimes_{A/\varpi^{n+1}}A/\varpi^n\cong L_n,\qquad L\cong\varprojlim_n\nu_W^*L_n.$$
The complex $L[0]$ belongs to the common sf/PBC integral constructible category, including its etale-origin witnesses. Call a classical lisse $E$-sheaf free-modelled if it is $(L_n)_n\otimes E$ for such a normalized system of finite locally free sheaves, that is, its lisse $\mathcal O_E$-sheaf has finite locally free reductions. Inverse limit in degree zero followed by raw rationalization therefore defines a functor from free-modelled classical lisse $E$-sheaves to the sf raw $E$-heart. Its composites with $\mathcal L_{W,E}$ and with $\mathcal R_{W,E}J_{W,E}$ are naturally the same functor $(L_n)_n\mapsto L[1/\varpi]$, on a localized map $f\otimes a$ acting by $a(1\otimes f)$. This classical realization is fully faithful. In particular, if $N$ is an sf raw $E$-heart object and $\mathcal R_{W,E}J_{W,E}N\cong L[1/\varpi]$ is specified, there is an sf raw isomorphism from the realization of $(L_n)_n\otimes_AE$ to $N$ inducing that specified module isomorphism.

Free-modelled sheaves are stable under finite coefficient extension. The compatible functors at finite $E$ induce a fully faithful realization from classical lisse $\Omega$-sheaves $(E,\mathcal F)$ with $\mathcal F$ free-modelled to the sf common-stage heart [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients]. On Hom groups it is the map of directed colimits of the finite-stage bijections. The finite-stage and common-stage realizations commute with further locally closed restriction and finite coefficient extension. The comparisons are induced by the actual quotient maps, balanced tensor maps and pulled-back basis vectors and satisfy the identity, composition and scalar associator equations.

At a geometric point $\bar x:\operatorname{Spec}k\to W$, the classical adic fibre, the sf completed point fibre and the PBC adic fibre are naturally identified with
$$(\varprojlim_n(L_n)_{\bar x})\otimes_AE,$$
and then with its scalar extension to $\Omega$ when appropriate [lem-per-adic-heart-pullback-fibres]. For any automorphism of $\operatorname{Spec}k$, this identification intertwines the point transport defined by restriction and the inverse-image coprojection, and every finite iterate, as in [lem-tw-lisse-rational-realization]. These comparisons also apply to the fibre of any heart object whose locally closed restriction is identified with the displayed realization, by the normalized completed-pullback comparison. Rank zero and empty schemes are included. The quotients $L_n$ are ordinary lattice quotients; no assertion about concentration of derived reductions of arbitrary torsion integral representatives is made.

proof.text: The finite ordinary module functor is fully faithful: the raw realization is fully faithful, the heart inclusion is fully faithful, and the sheaf realization induces Hom bijections on these lisse objects. Transfer this property along FiniteComparison.comparison. For scalar identity and composition, postcompose with the fully faithful raw realization followed by heart inclusion; compose inverses of the operation comparisons with the specified sf scalar unit or associator and the final operation comparison. Lift this natural isomorphism through fully faithful whiskering. map_preimage proves each scalar normalization equation exactly. For restriction, make the same lift through the fully faithful ordinary module realization using a.identity and a.composition. This constructs Coherence h without any further assumption.
